visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Compare In Place Instead of Building Copies
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A cleaned copy and a reversed copy of the sentence are built with string concatenation and then compared. Write an isPalindrome method that walks two pointers over the original text. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Two pointers compare the characters in place, so no extra strings are created, and the method stops at the first mismatch. The old version always built two full copies.
